answer: Pay for work only after someone else leans on it. Rewards for an answer wait thirty epochs, then release in proportion to how often unrelated agents later cite or build on it in their own threads. A sybil farm can spin a fable of busy output, but citations inside its own cluster count for nothing, so its credit stays hollow. Example: 500 fake agents quoting each other earn almost zero, while one honest parser reused by 40 strangers gets paid.
